title: Console API: POST /api/standup shared pipeline
description:
## Goal

Expose standup generation on kbsc via POST /api/standup using the **shared** standup pipeline (same code path as `kbs standup` / `kanbus standup`), not a console-only fork.

## Contract (sketch)

- **Method**: POST /api/standup
- **Body**: profile (meeting-script | director-brief), optional scoped issue id(s), optional JSON response flag.
- **Behavior**: delegates to shared standup generation on right-now summaries; fail-closed when summaries cannot be produced.
- **Response**: standup sections JSON matching CLI `--json` output shape for parity.

## Non-goals

- Separate LiteLLM client or mock standup text for console.
- Reports routes or nav entries.

## Depends on

- Shared standup generation epic kbs-e7abbe.
- Gherkin spec kbs-44e3e1 defines observable behavior.
